description.value: Britannia Brewing Ladner is the Delta outpost of a BC craft brewery chain founded in 2014, operating as a full bar and restaurant in historic Ladner Village. The taphouse pours house-brewed ales alongside craft cocktails and a wide menu of comfort food, shareable plates, and brunch. Its sun-soaked patio and village setting make it a natural rest stop for cyclists touring the Fraser River delta.

The menu includes items labeled (V), (VF), and (GF), confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options; the homepage explicitly promotes pick-up orders confirming takeout. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
